mapper.select: SELECT id, purchase_code, initiation_id, vendor, item_name, quantity, unit_price, amount, purchase_date, status, applicant_id, applicant_name, approver_id, approver_name, approved_at, description, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_cost_purchase WHERE purchase_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_cost_purchase SET status = #{status}, approver_id = COALESCE(#{approverId}, approver_id), approver_name = COALESCE(#{approverName}, approver_name), approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE approved_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
